title: Step the attractor down on the frames a reader sees
acceptance: A window steps down when its median frame is slower than 30 fps or its slow tail passes 50 ms; a steady 30 Hz host keeps full detail.
A step never changes system, palette or form.
The reader intensity control still changes the drawing at the lowest detail.

evidence.note: Package B1; question Q5. Owner decision 2026-10-05: the 25 fps threshold from #371 was not deliberate; adopt the median/p95 rule.
Median and p95 step-down with a 5% jitter margin; policy and control-visibility tests.

summary: The attractor steps detail down when its median frame is slower than 30 fps or its slow tail passes 50 ms, replacing the 25 fps mean threshold.
